# participation participant

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:participationParticipant`](gmeow-participationParticipant.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/participationParticipant>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The entity that took part in the event in this participation. Range is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) (not only [`Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)) to admit non-agent participants — a document signed, a place visited. Non-functional: a joint role may be borne by several participants.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:participationParticipant`](gmeow-participationParticipant.md) from [`gmeow:Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

```turtle
# --- Reified participations: the two principals and the officiant, with roles.
#     A withdrawn or disputed role would coexist as another Participation
#     (displayable false, or standpoint-indexed) — never overwritten (P9/P10).
ex:partAlex a gmeow:Participation ;
    gmeow:participationEvent ex:wedding ;
    gmeow:participationParticipant ex:alex ;
    gmeow:participationRole gmeow:roleParticipantPrincipal .

ex:partSam a gmeow:Participation ;
    gmeow:participationEvent ex:wedding ;
    gmeow:participationParticipant ex:sam ;
    gmeow:participationRole gmeow:roleParticipantPrincipal .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) to the entity that took part — an agent OR a non-agent (a document signed, a place visited), since the range is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid the flat [`gmeow:hasParticipant`](gmeow-hasParticipant.md) when you have already reified to a [`Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) (state the player here instead), and avoid restricting it to agents — non-agent participants are admitted by design.

### How to use

- Assert one or more [`gmeow:participationParticipant`](gmeow-participationParticipant.md) per [`Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) (non-functional, so joint roles are several players); pair with [`gmeow:participationEvent`](gmeow-participationEvent.md) and [`gmeow:participationRole`](gmeow-participationRole.md).

### Examples

- ex:p1 [`gmeow:participationParticipant`](gmeow-participationParticipant.md) ex:priest.
